chunks.text: This Customer Service Agreement (the "Agreement") is between Meridian Freight Co., an Ohio corporation with its head office at 2400 Harbor Logistics Drive, Columbus, Ohio ("Meridian"), and the business customer named in the signed order form (the "Customer"). The Agreement governs all transportation, warehousing and related services Meridian provides to the Customer. If the order form and these terms conflict, the order form prevails. Terms printed on the Customer's purchase orders or shipping documents do not apply, even if Meridian signs or accepts them.

Meridian offers the following services: Full truckload (FTL): a dedicated trailer for one Customer's goods, from pickup to delivery. Less than truckload (LTL): shipments of 1 to 6 pallets combined with other customers' goods. Warehousing: storage, picking, packing and cross-docking in Meridian's warehouses in Columbus, Louisville and Indianapolis. Last-mile delivery: delivery to business addresses within 150 miles of a Meridian warehouse. Meridian does not deliver to private residences, and does not transport live animals, cash, precious metals, firearms or perishable goods requiring refrigeration.

Quotes are valid for 14 calendar days from the date they are issued. Prices include all standard handling but exclude the fuel surcharge, accessorial charges and taxes. The fuel surcharge is adjusted every Monday based on the U.S. national average diesel price published by the Energy Information Administration.

chunks.section: 3. Quotes, orders and pickups › 3.2 Booking a pickup
chunks.text: Pickups must be booked through the customer portal at least 24 hours in advance. Same-day pickups are available when booked before 11:00 AM local time, subject to capacity, for a fee of $95 per pickup. Standard pickup hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday.

chunks.section: 3. Quotes, orders and pickups › 3.3 Shipment preparation
chunks.text: The Customer must package goods to withstand normal transportation, palletize them where required, and label each package with the delivery address and the Meridian shipment number. Pallets must not exceed 2,200 pounds or 72 inches in height. Meridian may refuse or re-package shipments that are not properly prepared, at the Customer's expense.

Estimated transit times are shown in the customer portal. Meridian aims to deliver every shipment on the estimated date but does not guarantee delivery dates unless the Customer buys the Guaranteed Delivery option, which costs 18% of the freight charge. If a guaranteed shipment is delivered late for reasons within Meridian's control, the Guaranteed Delivery fee and the freight charge for that shipment are refunded in full.

Each pickup and delivery includes 2 hours of free time for loading or unloading. After that, detention is charged at $75 per hour, billed in 15-minute increments. If a delivery cannot be completed because the receiver is closed or refuses the goods, Meridian returns the shipment to the nearest warehouse and charges a redelivery fee of $150, plus storage.

chunks.section: 5. Charges and payment › 5.1 Invoices and payment terms
chunks.text: Meridian invoices weekly. Invoices are payable within 30 days of the invoice date (net 30). Overdue amounts bear interest at 1.5% per month, or the maximum rate allowed by law if lower. Meridian may suspend services if any invoice is more than 45 days overdue, after giving the Customer 5 business days of written notice.

The Customer must notify Meridian in writing of any disputed invoice within 15 days of the invoice date, explaining the reason. The Customer must pay the undisputed part of the invoice on time. Invoices not disputed within 15 days are considered accepted.

Service: Same-day pickup · Charge: $95 per pickup. Service: Detention after 2 free hours · Charge: $75 per hour. Service: Liftgate service · Charge: $65 per stop. Service: Inside delivery · Charge: $85 per stop. Service: Redelivery · Charge: $150 per attempt. Service: Hazardous materials handling · Charge: $120 per shipment. Service: Address correction · Charge: $25 per shipment.

Storage is billed per pallet position per month at $18, with a minimum charge of $250 per month. Cross-docked goods may be stored free of charge for up to 7 calendar days after arrival; from the eighth day, the standard storage rate applies. Inbound receiving is charged at $6 per pallet and outbound handling at $6 per pallet. Meridian performs a full inventory count once a year at no charge. Additional counts requested by the Customer are billed at $55 per hour. Inventory differences of less than 0.5% of the units received in a year are considered normal and are not compensated.
Meridian accepts hazardous materials of the following U.S. Department of Transportation classes only: Class 3 (flammable liquids), Class 8 (corrosive materials) and Class 9 (miscellaneous dangerous

goods). The Customer must give written notice at least 48 hours before the pickup and provide the safety data sheet and correct shipping papers. Meridian does not accept explosives (Class 1), gases (Class 2), radioactive materials (Class 7) or any material that requires a hazardous materials security plan. The Customer is responsible for all costs, fines and damages caused by hazardous materials that were declared incorrectly or not declared.

chunks.section: 8. Liability for loss and damage › 8.1 Limit of liability
chunks.text: Meridian is liable for physical loss of or damage to goods while they are in its care, unless the loss was caused by the Customer, by the nature of the goods, or by a force majeure event. Meridian's liability is limited to the lower of the actual value of the goods or $2.50 per pound of the lost or damaged goods, with a maximum of $100,000 per shipment. Meridian is not liable for lost profits, delay or other indirect losses.

chunks.section: 8. Liability for loss and damage › 8.2 Declared value coverage
chunks.text: The Customer may increase Meridian's liability by declaring a higher value for a shipment at booking. Declared value coverage costs 0.8% of the declared value, with a minimum of $40 per shipment, and covers the declared value up to $500,000 per shipment.

chunks.section: 8. Liability for loss and damage › 8.3 Making a claim
chunks.text: 1. Visible damage or shortage must be noted on the delivery receipt when the shipment is delivered. 2. Concealed damage, meaning damage discovered after delivery when the packaging is opened, must be reported to Meridian in writing within 5 days of delivery. Keep the goods and packaging for inspection. 3. Formal claims must be filed in the customer portal within 9 months of the delivery date, or, for lost shipments, of the expected delivery date. Include the invoice for the goods and photos of the damage. 4. Meridian acknowledges claims within 30 days and pays approved claims within 30 days of approval.

chunks.section: 8. Liability for loss and damage › 8.3 Making a claim
chunks.text: Freight charges must be paid even when a claim is open; claim amounts may not be deducted from invoices.

Meridian targets an on-time delivery rate of 97%, measured each calendar quarter across all of the Customer's shipments, excluding delays caused by the Customer, the receiver or force majeure. If the on-time rate falls below 95% in a quarter, the Customer receives a credit of 5% of that quarter's freight charges, applied to the next invoice. The Customer can follow the on-time rate in the monthly report available in the customer portal.
Meridian maintains cargo insurance of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence and general liability insurance of at least $2,000,000 per occurrence, and provides certificates of insurance on request.

Neither party is responsible for delays or failures caused by events beyond its reasonable control, such as severe weather, natural disasters, war, strikes outside the party's own workforce, government actions or widespread infrastructure failures. If such an event lasts more than 30 days, either party may terminate the affected services with written notice.

Each party keeps the other party's non-public business information confidential and uses it only to perform this Agreement. This obligation lasts during the Agreement and for 3 years after it ends. Shipment data is processed according to Meridian's privacy notice; Meridian does not sell Customer data.

This Agreement starts on the date the order form is signed and lasts for one year. It renews automatically for successive one-year periods unless either party gives at least 60 days of written notice before the end of the current period. Either party may terminate the Agreement if the other party materially breaches it and does not fix the breach within 30 days of receiving written notice. On termination, the Customer must pay all outstanding invoices and collect any goods stored in Meridian's warehouses within 30 days. Goods not collected may be returned to the Customer at its expense.

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio. The parties will first try to resolve any dispute through good-faith negotiation between senior managers, then through mediation. If the dispute is not resolved within 60 days, it may be brought before the state or federal courts in Franklin County, Ohio. Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and sent by email to the contacts named in the order form, with a copy to legal@meridianfreight.example for notices to Meridian.

Meridian Freight Co. moves goods for more than 1,100 business customers across the Midwest. We were founded in 2009 in Columbus, Ohio, with two trucks and a rented loading dock. Today we employ around 640 people across our head office in Columbus and our three warehouses in Columbus, Louisville and Indianapolis. This handbook explains how we work together: your hours, your time off, your pay and benefits, and what we expect from each other. It applies to all employees in the United States. Where a local law gives you more rights than this handbook, the law wins. If something is unclear, ask your manager or write to People & Culture at hr@meridianfreight.example.
The handbook does not create a contract of employment. We review it every year and announce changes on the intranet at least 30 days before they take effect.

Every new employee starts with a probation period of 90 calendar days. During probation your manager meets with you at least every two weeks to give feedback. At the end of probation you receive a short written review. Probation can be extended once, by up to 30 days, if both you and your manager agree that more time is needed.

Category: Full-time · Definition: Scheduled for 40 hours per week. Category: Part-time · Definition: Scheduled for at least 20 and fewer than 40 hours per week. Category: Seasonal · Definition: Hired for a fixed period, usually October to January, for the peak season. Seasonal employees receive pay, overtime and sick leave as described in this handbook, but are not eligible for paid time off, parental leave or the learning budget.
Office hours at the head office are 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break. Warehouse teams work in three shifts:

Shift: Early · Hours: 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM · Shift premium: None. Shift: Late · Hours: 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM · Shift premium: $1.50 per hour. Shift: Night · Hours: 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM · Shift premium: $2.75 per hour. Shift schedules are published in ShiftBoard at least 14 days in advance. Shift swaps between colleagues are allowed when both employees hold the same certifications and the shift supervisor approves the swap in ShiftBoard before the shift begins.

Hourly employees clock in and out at the warehouse terminals. Salaried office employees submit a weekly timesheet in ShiftBoard by 3:00 PM every Friday. Timesheets submitted late are paid in the next pay cycle.
We believe good work can happen anywhere, but logistics is a team sport. Our hybrid model balances flexibility with time together.

chunks.section: 3. Remote and hybrid work › 3.1 Who can work remotely
chunks.text: Office-based employees may work remotely up to two days per week once they have completed their probation period. Warehouse, driver and facilities roles require physical presence and are not eligible for remote work. Your manager may ask you to come in on a remote day for training, a customer visit or an urgent operational need, with at least 24 hours of notice.

chunks.section: 3. Remote and hybrid work › 3.2 Team day and core hours
chunks.text: Tuesday is our team day: all office-based employees work from the office on Tuesdays. On remote days you must be reachable during our core hours, 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM Eastern Time, on Teams and by phone. You may choose your other remote day freely, including Mondays and Fridays, as long as your team keeps at least one person in the office each working day.

chunks.section: 3. Remote and hybrid work › 3.3 Working from abroad
chunks.text: You may work from another country for up to 10 working days per calendar year. Requests must be approved by People & Culture at least three weeks before you travel, because tax and immigration rules differ by country. You must also inform IT before you go (see the IT & Security Policy, section 4.3). Working from abroad is not allowed during your probation period.

chunks.section: 3. Remote and hybrid work › 3.4 Home office support
chunks.text: Eligible remote employees receive a one-time home office allowance of $300 for a chair, desk or monitor, and a monthly internet allowance of $40, paid with your salary. Keep receipts for the one- time allowance and submit them in Expensely within 60 days of purchase.

chunks.section: 4. Paid time off (PTO) › 4.1 How much PTO you receive
chunks.text: Full-time employees earn paid time off based on their years of service: Years of service: Less than 2 years · PTO days per year: 15 days. Years of service: 2 to 5 years · PTO days per year: 20 days. Years of service: More than 5 years · PTO days per year: 25 days. Part-time employees earn PTO in proportion to their scheduled hours. For example, an employee scheduled for 24 hours per week earns 60% of the full-time amount. PTO is earned monthly and can be used as soon as it is earned, including during probation.

chunks.section: 4. Paid time off (PTO) › 4.2 Requesting time off
chunks.text: Request PTO in ShiftBoard. For absences of three or more consecutive working days, submit your request at least two weeks in advance. Warehouse employees should avoid requesting PTO during the peak season from November 15 to December 31; requests in this period are approved only when the team's staffing plan allows it.

chunks.section: 4. Paid time off (PTO) › 4.3 Carrying PTO over
chunks.text: You may carry over up to 5 unused PTO days into the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be used by March 31; any carried-over days not used by then are lost. Unused days beyond the 5-day limit expire on December 31 and are not paid out, except when you leave the company (see section 13).

The head office closes on the following 10 paid holidays: New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, the day after Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. In addition, every employee receives one floating holiday per year, which can be used for any day of personal or cultural significance. Warehouses operate on some company holidays. Employees who work on a company holiday are paid double time for the hours worked and may take another day off within 60 days.

All employees, including seasonal employees, receive 10 paid sick days per calendar year. Sick days do not carry over and are not paid out when you leave. Sick days may also be used to care for a sick child, spouse or parent, or for medical appointments.

If you are sick, tell your manager before the start of your working day. Warehouse employees must call the shift supervisor at least two hours before their shift starts, so that the shift can be covered. A doctor's note is required if you are absent for more than three consecutive working days. If you are sick for longer than your paid sick days, you may use PTO or apply for short-term disability insurance, which pays 60% of your base salary for up to 26 weeks after a 7-day waiting period.

Employees with at least six months of service are eligible for paid parental leave after the birth or adoption of a child: Situation: Birthing parent · Paid leave: 16 weeks at full pay. Situation: Non-birthing parent · Paid leave: 8 weeks at full pay. Situation: Adoption or foster placement (each parent) · Paid leave: 8 weeks at full pay.

Parental leave must be taken within 12 months of the birth or placement and may be split into a maximum of two blocks. Please tell People & Culture at least 30 days before your leave starts when possible. After parental leave, you may return on a reduced schedule of 80% of your usual hours for up to 8 weeks, at full pay.

Bereavement leave: up to 5 paid days after the death of an immediate family member (spouse or partner, child, parent, sibling), and up to 2 paid days for other relatives. Jury duty: paid at your full salary for the duration of your service. Please share the court summons with your manager as soon as you receive it. Volunteer day: one paid day per year to volunteer for a registered non-profit organization. Moving day: one paid day when you move to a new home, once per calendar year. Military leave: unpaid leave as required by federal and state law, with the difference between military pay and your base salary paid by the company for up to 30 days per year.
Employees are paid every two weeks, on Fridays, by direct deposit. Pay statements are available in the Payroll portal. If a payday falls on a holiday, you are paid on the previous working day.

Hourly employees are paid 1.5 times their hourly rate for hours worked beyond 40 in a week, and 2 times their hourly rate for hours worked on a company holiday. Overtime must be approved by your supervisor in advance, except in emergencies. Salaried employees are not eligible for overtime pay.
Salaries are reviewed once a year after the December performance review. Pay increases take effect on April 1.

Medical, dental and vision coverage begins on the first day of the month after your start date. If you start on the first day of a month, coverage begins that same day. Meridian pays 80% of the premium for employee coverage and 60% of the premium for dependents. You can enroll or change your plan within 30 days of starting, during open enrollment in November, or within 30 days of a life event such as marriage or the birth of a child.

Employees may join the 401(k) plan from their first day. Meridian matches 100% of your contributions up to 4% of your salary. Company contributions vest immediately, which means they belong to you from day one.

Benefit: Learning budget · Amount: $1,200 per calendar year · How to claim: Pre-approval from your manager, then Expensely. Gym or fitness reimbursement Employee assistance program 6 free counseling sessions per issue Call the EAP line, confidential

The learning budget covers courses, certifications, conferences and books related to your current or future role. Unused learning budget does not carry over to the next year. If you leave within 12 months of completing a course that cost more than $800, you may be asked to repay part of it.

If you refer a candidate who is hired, you receive a referral bonus of $1,500 for office roles and $750 for warehouse and driver roles. The bonus is paid once the new employee has completed 90 days of employment. Managers referring candidates for their own team are not eligible.

We reimburse reasonable expenses you pay for while doing your job. Submit all expenses in Expensely within 30 days of the purchase. A receipt is required for any expense over $25. Expenses submitted more than 90 days late will not be reimbursed.

chunks.section: 10. Expenses and business travel › 10.1 Travel limits
chunks.text: Item: Meals (per diem) · Limit: $60 per day in the US, $85 per day abroad. Item: Hotel · Limit: Up to $220 per night; up to $300 per night in New York, San Francisco and Boston. Item: Flights · Limit: Economy class for flights under 6 hours; premium economy for flights of 6 hours or more. Item: Personal car · Limit: 67 cents per mile, plus parking and tolls. Item: Rental car · Limit: Compact or midsize class, booked through the travel portal. Book flights and hotels through the company travel portal at least 14 days in advance when possible. Alcohol is not reimbursed, except as part of approved client entertainment.

chunks.section: 10. Expenses and business travel › 10.2 Client entertainment
chunks.text: Client meals and events are reimbursed when they have a clear business purpose. Any client entertainment above $250 in total requires approval from a director before the event. Record the names of the guests and their companies in Expensely.

chunks.section: 10. Expenses and business travel › 10.3 Corporate cards
chunks.text: Employees who travel more than four times per year can request a corporate card. The corporate card must not be used for personal purchases, even if you plan to pay them back.

Office employees receive a laptop, a headset and a phone if their role requires one. Laptops are replaced every three years. Employees in on-call roles receive a phone allowance of $50 per month instead of a company phone. If your laptop or phone is lost or stolen, report it to the IT Service Desk immediately, and in any case within 24 hours, so the device can be locked remotely. You may be asked to pay up to $250 toward a replacement if the loss was caused by clear negligence, such as leaving the laptop visible in an unlocked car.

The dress code at the head office is business casual. In the warehouses, safety boots and a high- visibility vest are required at all times on the warehouse floor. Safety glasses are also required in Zone B (packaging and strapping).

chunks.section: 12. Conduct and safety › 12.2 Gifts and conflicts of interest
chunks.text: You may accept gifts from customers or suppliers worth up to $75 per year from any one company. Cash and gift cards may never be accepted. If you have a personal relationship or financial interest that could affect your decisions at work, disclose it to People & Culture using the conflict of interest form.

Only certified employees may operate forklifts and pallet jacks. Forklift certification is provided by Meridian and must be renewed every three years. Report any injury, however small, to your supervisor within 24 hours, and report near misses through the Safety app. Smoking and vaping are allowed only in the marked areas outside each building.

chunks.section: 13. Performance and leaving the company › 13.1 Performance reviews
chunks.text: Performance reviews take place twice a year, in June and December. The December review is used for pay reviews and promotions. Promotions are announced in March.

chunks.section: 13. Performance and leaving the company › 13.2 Resigning
chunks.text: If you decide to leave, please give at least two weeks of written notice. Managers and directors are asked to give four weeks of notice. Unused PTO earned in the current year is paid out in your final paycheck; sick days are not paid out. Return your laptop, badge, phone and any other company property within 5 working days of your last day. You will be invited to an optional exit interview with People & Culture. Former employees who left in good standing are welcome to apply again; their years of service are restored if they return within 12 months.

This policy explains how we protect Meridian's systems and the information our customers trust us with. It applies to all employees, contractors and temporary staff who use a Meridian account or device, whether they work in an office, in a warehouse or remotely. Breaking this policy can expose the company to fraud, data loss and legal penalties. Serious or repeated violations may lead to disciplinary action. If you are unsure whether something is allowed, ask the IT Service Desk before you do it.

Channel: IT Service Desk portal · Details: servicedesk.meridianfreight.example — for requests and non-urgent issues. Channel: Phone · Details: Extension 4357 (HELP), Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM Eastern Time. Channel: After-hours emergencies · Details: On-call engineer at 614-555-0199, 24/7, for outages and security incidents only. Standard requests are answered within one business day. Requests for new software are reviewed within three business days.

Passwords for Meridian accounts must be at least 14 characters long. We recommend a passphrase of four or more unrelated words. You do not need to change your password on a schedule; you must change it immediately if you think it may have been seen or stolen. Never reuse your Meridian password on any other website. Store passwords only in the company password manager, which IT installs on every laptop. Writing passwords on paper or saving them in documents, spreadsheets or browser notes is not allowed.

Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is required for all Meridian accounts. Use the approved authenticator app on your phone. Text-message codes are allowed only as a temporary backup for up to 7 days, for example while you replace a lost phone. Never approve an MFA request you did not start yourself; report it to the Service Desk as a possible attack.

Shared accounts are not allowed, except for the warehouse terminals, which use badge login. Never share your password or MFA codes with anyone, including your manager or IT staff. IT will never ask for your password.

Company data may only be stored and processed on company-managed devices. All company laptops use full-disk encryption and lock the screen automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity. Lock your screen manually (Windows key + L) whenever you step away. Do not disable antivirus, encryption or automatic updates. Updates must be installed within 7 days of being released.

You may use your personal phone for email, Teams and the ShiftBoard app, but only after enrolling it in the company's mobile device management (MDM) app. MDM lets IT erase company data from the phone if it is lost or when you leave Meridian; it cannot see your personal photos, messages or browsing history. Personal laptops and tablets may not be used to access company systems, except the Payroll portal.

Use the company VPN whenever you access internal systems such as ShiftBoard, the finance system or file shares from outside a Meridian office. The VPN is always required on public Wi-Fi, such as in hotels, airports and cafés. At home, the VPN is required for internal systems but not for email, Teams or other cloud applications.

If you plan to work from another country, inform the IT Service Desk at least 5 working days before you travel, after your request has been approved by People & Culture. Some countries block our VPN or restrict encryption software; in these countries IT may provide a temporary loan laptop. Company devices may not be taken to countries on the restricted list published on the IT intranet page.

Report a lost or stolen laptop or phone to the IT Service Desk immediately, and no later than 24 hours after you notice it is missing. Outside business hours, call the on-call engineer. IT will lock the device and erase company data remotely. Also report thefts to the police and send the report number to the Service Desk.

chunks.section: 5. Software and AI tools › 5.1 Installing software
chunks.text: Install software only from the Software Center on your laptop. If the software you need is not available, request it through the Service Desk portal. IT checks each new request for security and licensing, and replies within three business days. Browser extensions follow the same rule: only extensions listed in the Software Center may be installed.

chunks.section: 5. Software and AI tools › 5.2 Using AI tools
chunks.text: Meridian provides an approved AI assistant for writing, summarizing and analysis, available from the Software Center. You may use it with Public and Internal information. Confidential and Restricted information must never be entered into any AI tool other than the approved assistant, and Restricted information must never be entered into any AI tool at all. Always check AI-generated content before you share it: you remain responsible for its accuracy.

All information at Meridian falls into one of four classes. Label documents with their class when they are Confidential or Restricted. Class: Public · Examples: Website content, press releases, published price lists. No restrictions Share only with employees and contractors Share only with people who need it for their work; never on USB drives Access approved by the data owner; encrypted when sent outside Meridian; never on USB drives or personal devices

USB drives and other removable storage are blocked on company laptops by default. If you need to exchange large files with a customer, use the secure file transfer service instead. Paper documents with Confidential or Restricted information must be stored in locked cabinets and destroyed in the shredding bins, not in regular recycling.

Most attacks start with an email. Be careful with messages that create urgency, ask you to change bank details, or ask for passwords or gift cards. Emails from outside Meridian are marked with an orange

"External" banner. If you receive a suspicious email, do not click links or open attachments. Use the "Report phishing" button in Outlook, which sends the message to the security team and removes it from your inbox. If you already clicked a link or entered your password, call the Service Desk right away; quick action makes a big difference. You will not be blamed for reporting a mistake. Any request to change a customer's or supplier's bank details must be confirmed by phone, using a number already on file, before the change is made. Never use the phone number written in the email itself.

A security incident is any event that could harm the confidentiality, integrity or availability of our information: a lost device, a suspicious login, malware, data sent to the wrong person, or an unknown person in a restricted area. Report every incident to the Service Desk as soon as possible, and within 1 hour if it involves Restricted information. Do not try to investigate on your own, and do not delete any evidence. The security team classifies incidents by severity and keeps you informed. If personal data was exposed, the Legal team decides whether customers, employees or authorities must be notified.

Files saved on the company file shares and in the cloud storage are backed up every day, and backups are kept for 35 days. Files saved only on your laptop's desktop are not backed up. Emails are kept for 3 years and then deleted automatically, unless the Legal team has placed them on hold.

Wear your badge visibly in all Meridian buildings. Do not let people follow you through a badge- controlled door. Visitors must sign in at reception, wear a visitor badge and be accompanied at all times in warehouses and server rooms. Guests can use the "Meridian-Guest" Wi-Fi network. The guest password changes on the first day of each month and is available at reception. The guest network has no access to internal systems. Employees should not connect company laptops to the guest network.

Your accounts are disabled at the end of your last working day. Before you leave, move any work files you created to the team file share, and remove personal files from your laptop. On your last day, return your laptop and badge to your manager or to the IT Service Desk, and remove the MDM app from your personal phone, which erases company data from it.
